chapter: Closing: recent career, family and travel
title: The suite "Hills of New York" and composing
summary: He is still working on the suite and says he is not a real songwriter.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Years ago you were supposed to be writing a suite, "The Hills Of New York."
Oh my goodness! You remember that?
You know, I'm still working on it!
But it was a good idea.

I have been sidetracked several times. You know, with my lifestyle, sometimes things get... I do a lot of traveling. I don't stay in one place too long. This is the first time, around now, that I've been sitting in one place. I don't know, I've wanted to sit down to serious writing many times, but I always find something that will distract me, and I'm going again, you know. But I mean, I'm just waiting... It's a good thing to... It's a good goal to have...

I think it's like having extra strings to your bow. I mean, you've got "Lover Man," so you... It would be good to emphasize the compositional angle a little bit. "Mad About You" and that other one, "I Just Refuse To Sing The Blues" are...
You know, I'm not a real songwriter per se.
These are things that I wrote for bands, and people used to like certain themes, you know.
But I mean, you don't have to have lyrics to them all. Perhaps you could have more of your own...
Well, I think you should play more of your own material and your own interests.
Well, frankly, I don't have enough for a whole evening...
Well, maybe not. But you should work on that.
A lot of times I have the urge, really.
